metadata.title: Ant Colony Optimization for Energy-Efficient Train Operations
metadata.source_file: Naldini et al. - 2021 - Ant colony optimization for energy-efficient train operations.pdf

the_domain.problem_context: Real-time Energy Consumption Minimization Problem (rtECMP) in railway networks

the_database.dataset_name: 50 instances derived from the peak-hour traffic in the French Pierrefitte-Gonesse control area

performance_outcome.metric: Improvement of the best solution w.r.t. the first iteration within 30 seconds
